% macro_heavy_standin.tex — a SYNTHETIC stand-in, NOT anyone's CV.
%
% It exists to reproduce the macro/escape shapes that defeat a raw-substring
% grounding test: an \href{URL}{label} whose visible label is only contiguous
% after rendering, a \texttimes that renders to ×, a \& that renders to &, a
% heading set spanning experience, projects, education and volunteering, and an
% awesome-cv \cventry shape whose org and location sit in SEPARATE adjacent
% arguments. The people, employers, schools and links below are invented and use
% the reserved .invalid TLD, so none can ever resolve.
%
% NO REAL CV CONTENT MAY EVER BE ADDED TO THIS FILE (D-58).
% =============================================================================

\newcommand{\cventry}[5]{%
  \noindent\textbf{#1} --- \textit{#2} \hfill #3 \hfill #4\par

}
